title: Research-only cached Jacobian provider with end-to-end routing
objective: Test whether compiler-derived coloring cached behind an unexported research-only Jacobian-provider seam and selected by a frozen identity-free structural route improves fully charged end-to-end local-solver performance without changing the public solver surface, canonical semantics, recall, fallback safety or black-box DSL expressivity.
hypothesis: Against the unchanged public dense solve_local control, a research-only cached-and-routed provider will reduce fully charged end-to-end wall by at least ten percent and oracle work by at least twenty percent on three new unrelated sparse black-box families, while keeping dense controls within five percent overhead and preserving zero semantic and recall regressions.

included: The unchanged exported solve_local dense finite-difference control
Removal of the EXP-JAC-002 prepared_coloring public keyword before any candidate run
One behavior-preserving unexported internal Jacobian-provider kernel shared by the public dense path and research extension
A sealed immutable compiler-derived natural coloring constructed once per compiled research runner
The unchanged JAC002 structural-only route formula over n, residual count, structural nonzeros and color count
Central grouped probes, one-sided bound handling, every affected-column fallback and unchanged canonical endpoint replay
Counterbalanced host-exclusive fresh-process wall measurement including compile, provider construction and all 32 starts
excluded: Any EXP-JAC-002 graph, matrix, start, seed, family or serialized input as a development or locked observation
Any exported Jacobian-provider type, function, keyword or public solve option
Any _CompiledAttemptRunner, solve protocol, SOLVE_API_VERSION, wire schema or checkpoint identity connection before locked pass
Retuning the route formula, finite-difference step, local stopping policy or recall tolerance from observed outcomes
Automatic differentiation, analytic Jacobians, Hessian coloring or sampled sparsity discovery
Using cache-only microbenchmarks as promotion or kill criteria

literature.claim: Structurally noninterfering finite-difference Jacobian columns can be grouped through coloring of the column-intersection graph.
literature.assumptions: The structural sparsity pattern conservatively contains every represented derivative and decompression maps each entry to the correct column.
literature.break_conditions: An omitted dependency or overlapping same-color support silently corrupts a derivative.

literature.claim: A precomputed color vector can separate reusable structural preparation from repeated sparse derivative evaluations.
literature.assumptions: The structure and color vector remain immutable and belong to exactly one compiled problem.
literature.break_conditions: Cross-problem reuse, mutable supports or per-attempt reconstruction invalidates semantics or economics.

literature.claim: Julia performance measurements must distinguish compilation and specialization effects from warm kernel execution and use deliberate function barriers.
literature.assumptions: Compilation, allocation and runtime costs are all recorded under the target Julia version.
literature.break_conditions: First-use compilation or tuple-length specialization is omitted from the claimed end-to-end cost.

controls.description: The exported solve_local public path with normalized column-wise central finite differences and no research provider.
A report-only research attribution probe that reconstructs coloring per attempt on one frozen case and eight starts per eligible family.
A test-only omitted compiler dependency that must be detected by frozen dense differential comparison.

candidates.description: A sealed cached natural coloring supplied only through the unexported provider kernel and selected by the frozen structural-only route.
differences_from_baseline: One immutable verified coloring per compiled research runner
Grouped finite-difference probes on eligible structures
Individual-column fallback on every unusable group

synthetic_families.purpose: Exercise arbitrary differentiable black-box plugin primitives on shuffled tree dependencies with bounded color count.
synthetic_families.gold_source: Independent analytic roots and Jacobians for a new sine-and-cosine tree plugin

synthetic_families.purpose: Measure coloring and fallback on smooth safe-rational residuals with irregular overlapping hyperedges.
synthetic_families.gold_source: Materialized analytic rational systems with denominators independently bounded away from zero

synthetic_families.purpose: Test two-dimensional nonrectangular local coupling and natural coloring on hexagonal rings and wrapped seams.
synthetic_families.gold_source: Independent axial-coordinate roots and sparse analytic Jacobians from a new hex-ring generator

synthetic_families.purpose: Force the identity-free route to retain dense finite differences on dense, marginal-color, bound and branch-chart cases.
synthetic_families.gold_source: Independent analytic roots, branch labels and dense Jacobians from new switch and piecewise plugin primitives

execution_order: Commit this card before generator or mechanism work
Create and checksum entirely new development generators, typed graphs, starts, truth, dense Jacobian traces and pre-refactor public-control traces
Freeze the card copy and development inputs before numerical mechanism implementation
Remove prepared_coloring from the exported solve_local signature and prove the public dense surface, SOLVE_API_VERSION and checkpoint identity match the pre-EXP-JAC-002 baseline
Extract one unexported provider kernel without duplicating the local iteration loop, then implement the sealed provider only in the research extension
Run safety differential, negative, fallback, public-surface and frozen-control replay tests
Run K0/K1/K1/K0 in fresh single-thread processes under one cross-worktree exclusive audit; run KA only on its fixed report-only subset
If and only if every development criterion passes, create and freeze new generator-family-disjoint locked inputs
Run the frozen candidate on locked inputs under the same exclusive audit and connect product only after every locked criterion passes
design.pairing: K0 and K1 receive byte-identical graphs, starts, bounds, local budgets and canonical validators. The counterbalanced K0/K1/K1/K0 fresh-process order is fixed. Fully charged totals include graph compilation, provider construction, routing, every grouped and fallback callback, decompression, factorization, allocations and endpoint replay.
design.freeze_rule: Generators, seeds, route, provider lifetime, run order, attribution subset, thresholds and analysis code freeze before mechanism implementation; any development miss is terminal rather than a tuning round.
design.locked_validation_rule: Locked generators do not exist until development passes. Once frozen they remain untouched; any inspected mismatch burns the affected family block and production remains disconnected.

public_surface_baseline.value: pre-EXP-JAC-002 exported solve_local signature with no prepared_coloring keyword
public_surface_baseline.rationale: The successor must repair the protocol deviation before measuring a candidate.
public_surface_baseline.freeze_rule: Any public method, export, solve option, API version or checkpoint identity drift kills the experiment.

research_seam.value: unexported shared jacobian-provider kernel plus research extension provider
research_seam.rationale: A shared internal loop avoids solver duplication while keeping provider construction off the public callable surface.
research_seam.freeze_rule: No exported type, function or keyword and no _CompiledAttemptRunner connection is allowed before locked pass.

routing_formula.rationale: This formula was frozen before JAC002 outcomes and is carried forward without outcome-based retuning.
routing_formula.freeze_rule: No coefficient, threshold or input changes are allowed in EXP-JAC-003.

cache_lifetime.value: one sealed immutable provider per compiled research runner
cache_lifetime.rationale: Compiler structure is immutable for one compiled problem and must never cross problem identity.
cache_lifetime.freeze_rule: No per-attempt rebuild in K1 and no cross-problem cache reuse.

measurement_order.rationale: A counterbalanced order reduces monotonic host and compilation drift without choosing an order after outcomes.
measurement_order.freeze_rule: Every formal development and locked run uses this exact order in fresh processes.

fixed_starts_per_instance.rationale: Fixed prefixes retain paired anytime and fully charged compiled-runner comparisons.
fixed_starts_per_instance.freeze_rule: All starts are materialized and checksummed before mechanism implementation.

attribution_subset.value: lowest canonical case_id in each eligible family, starts 1 through 8
attribution_subset.rationale: A small report-only rebuild control can diagnose construction effects without dominating or gating the main comparison.
tuning_domain: one case times eight starts per eligible family
attribution_subset.freeze_rule: KA never selects, promotes, rejects or changes K1 and is not run on locked inputs.

budgets.accounting: Charge graph compilation, public-control or provider setup, route decisions, all grouped failures and column fallback, decompression, factorization, allocations, canonical replay and the complete 32-start wall. Execute under the cross-worktree exclusive lease and preserve its atomic audit.

seeds.generation: Development uses new generator namespace jac3-v1 with instance seeds 2730000+family*100+index and start seeds 2830000+family*100+index. It may not import InputJac002, copy any JAC002 materialized object, or use a JAC001/JAC002 seed. Locked namespaces and generator families are created only after development passes and must be disjoint from every prior family and seed.

primary.definition: Counterbalanced fresh-process wall from graph compilation through provider setup, all 32 local attempts and canonical endpoint replay, aggregated without subtracting cache or compilation costs.

secondary.definition: Primal-equivalent oracle work including grouped failures, every fallback column and canonical validation replay.
Fraction of starts reaching a canonical-valid independently matched Gold configuration and target.
Fraction of attempts routed to the research provider by frozen structural stratum.
Provider construction divided by the fully charged compiled-runner wall, reported diagnostically and never gated.
Fixed-subset K1 versus per-attempt rebuild timing reported for mechanism attribution only.
Fraction of colored groups that retry individual columns.

safety.definition: Research-provider entries outside frozen dense tolerance or dense nonzeros outside compiler structure.
Accepted endpoints outside canonical replay or independent Gold truth.
Any callback, iteration or attempt wall beyond a declared hard budget.
Any route access to IDs, names, values, targets, Gold data or prior outcomes.
Any exported method, keyword, option, SOLVE_API_VERSION, wire schema or checkpoint identity difference from the frozen public baseline.
Any public dense status, endpoint, evaluation or canonical decision drift from pre-implementation frozen traces.
Any overlapping formal lease owner or observed non-experiment CPU or memory heavy process during a wall run.

criteria: Every safety metric is zero, every incomplete-pattern negative is detected and every forced unusable group retries all affected columns.

The exported solve_local signature has no prepared_coloring keyword, the dense public path replays every frozen control trace, and SOLVE_API_VERSION, wire schemas and checkpoint identity are unchanged.
K1 loses no more than two P_local_gold points overall or in any family, branch, boundary or generator stratum.
K1 reduces eligible-family oracle work by at least twenty percent with a family-clustered one-sided 95 percent lower bound above zero in all three unrelated eligible families.

K1 improves fully charged counterbalanced end-to-end wall by at least ten percent overall with a family-clustered one-sided 95 percent lower bound above zero, and neither K1 repetition has an overall wall regression.
The dense/branch control family has at most five percent fully charged wall overhead without recall gain, and every case with color_count divided by variable_count at least 0.8 routes to dense.
The exclusive-run audit covers the complete K0/K1/K1/K0 sequence with zero host-contention events and all checksummed staging artifacts are atomically published.
Any public-surface, frozen-control, dense differential, false-candidate, budget, identity-routing or fallback safety count is nonzero.
Any formal worker overlaps another lease owner, CI, compiler experiment, benchmark or CPU or memory heavy process.
P_local_gold loses more than two points in any required stratum.
Eligible-family oracle-work reduction is below ten percent after fallback in any eligible family.
Fully charged K1 end-to-end wall exceeds K0 overall, or dense/branch overhead exceeds five percent without recall gain.
Any JAC001 or JAC002 graph, seed, family, start, matrix or serialized input enters development or locked evaluation.

safety_invariants: JAC001 and JAC002 inputs and outcomes are pilot-only and unavailable to formal JAC003 development or locked evaluation.
The public solve_local signature is restored before candidate execution and no provider is exported or passed through public kwargs.
The only pre-locked core refactor authorized after input freeze is a behavior-preserving unexported provider kernel shared with the unchanged public dense path.
The sealed provider validates immutable supports, exact structural nonzero count, complete unique column partition and pairwise-disjoint same-color rows once at construction.
Only compiler-transitive dependencies construct the provider and the route receives only n, residual count, structural nonzeros and color count.
Every unusable group retries every affected column or fails closed within budget.
Every endpoint is replayed through the unchanged canonical validation pipeline.
Cache construction and route work are never subtracted from end-to-end wall; cache micro metrics are report-only.
No _CompiledAttemptRunner, solve protocol, SOLVE_API_VERSION, wire schema or checkpoint change occurs before a generator-disjoint locked pass.

decision.rationale: The sole frozen formal development launch terminated before K0 preflight because the Julia-produced JSON number representation was incompatible with the frozen Python assessor's exact-float requirement. No ABBA segment, official archive or eligible formal development outcome exists, and independent host observation also disqualified wall-time claims. EXP-JAC-003 is terminal under its frozen no-retry rule. This neither rejects nor promotes cached Jacobians; locked inputs were never materialized or opened and production remains disconnected.
